falsifiable_hypothesis: Global-vector and fold-wide common-mode James-Stein factors are two independent evidence channels for whether hierarchical refinement is warranted. Summing those reliabilities and capping at one is a parameter-free saturated evidence rule that is more assertive than probabilistic union only when both channels are credible.
component_rule: Orientation A is leave-one-whole-patient bagged geometry. Orientation B starts from interpolated-jackknife geometry. No A/B prediction averaging occurs.
shrinkage_rule: Using the same three authenticated inner whole-patient bandwidth-0.7 OOF contrast vectors, compute theta_global, theta_hier, a_global and a_common exactly as in union_reliability_hierarchical_js. Set w=min(1,a_global+a_common), theta=(1-w)*theta_global+w*theta_hier, and q_B=q_B,interpolated_jackknife-0.5*theta. No free tuning parameter, target/fold outer routing, or protected data is used.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
